channel.title: Capacity · compute.world
channel.description: Issuer-disclosed company MW, desk-sourced from SEC EDGAR and official IR. Snapshot 2026-09-18. 17 companies. Not a comps product. Not EV/MW.

item.title: Digital Realty · live 3,100 MW
item.description: Digital Realty (Colo). Live 3,100 MW. Digital Realty’s portfolio is comprised of approximately 3.1 gigawatts of IT capacity

item.title: MARA Holdings · live 1,900 MW
item.description: MARA Holdings (Miner → AI). Live 1,900 MW. As of June 30, 2026, our total energy portfolio consists of approximately 1.9 gigawatts (“GW”) of capacity across 19 data centers

item.title: CoreWeave · live 1,500 MW
item.description: CoreWeave (Neocloud). Live 1,500 MW. Expanded active power by nearly 500 MWs to reach 1.5 GW

item.title: Hut 8 · live 710 MW
item.description: Hut 8 (Miner → AI). Live 710 MW. Energy Capacity Under Management was 710 MW as of June 30, 2026, compared to 1,020 MW as of June 30, 2025

item.title: Riot Platforms · live 700 MW
item.description: Riot Platforms (Miner → AI). Live 700 MW. The Rockdale Facility currently provides up to approximately 700 megawatts (“MW”) of developed capacity for Bitcoin Mining and data center leasing.

item.title: Core Scientific · live 395 MW
item.description: Core Scientific (Miner → AI). Live 395 MW. Billable customer power capacity of 395 MW as of June 30, 2026, against 590 MW of leased customer power capacity

item.title: Cipher Mining · live 207 MW
item.description: Cipher Mining (Miner → AI). Live 207 MW. we currently operate approximately 207 MW of capacity at one bitcoin mining data center in Texas

item.title: Nebius Group · live 170 MW
item.description: Nebius Group (Neocloud). Live 170 MW. As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 170 MW of active power capacity across the globe

item.title: TeraWulf · live 102 MW
item.description: TeraWulf (Miner → AI). Live 102 MW. completed delivery of CB-3 in early July, increasing revenue-generating capacity to 102 MW

item.title: Applied Digital · live 100 MW
item.description: Applied Digital (Ground-up). Live 100 MW. of which approximately 100 MW was operating and revenue-generating

item.title: IREN · live 40 MW
item.description: IREN (Miner → AI). Live 40 MW. As of June 30, 2026, our operating AI Cloud Services capacity represented approximately 40MW.

item.title: HIVE Digital Technologies · live 16.6 MW
item.description: HIVE Digital Technologies (Miner → AI). Live 16.6 MW. This expansion represents growth from 4 MW in Manitoba to 16.6 MW of critical IT load across two Provinces of Canada

item.title: CleanSpark · live undisclosed
item.description: CleanSpark (Miner → AI). Live undisclosed. Latest 10-Q does not print a single operational mining or AI IT MW. 1,817 MW is contracted power across mining sites, not live AI load. Texas 885 MW is an LOI/exclusivity print, so it is estimated and excluded from portfolio totals.

item.title: Equinix · live undisclosed
item.description: Equinix (Colo). Live undisclosed. Latest 10-K/10-Q prints PPA megawatts and anecdotal xScale builds, not a consolidated AI-critical-IT live MW. Dash stays dash.

item.title: Lambda · live undisclosed
item.description: Lambda (Neocloud). Live undisclosed. Private. No EDGAR operating KPI. Locations live on the Neoclouds catalog. MW stays undisclosed until a company primary states a number with a URL.

item.title: Crusoe · live undisclosed
item.description: Crusoe (Other). Live undisclosed. Private. Named campus pins may appear in the Campuses register; that is project grain, not an issuer Live/Contracted book. No company-level MW stored here.

item.title: Fluidstack · live undisclosed
item.description: Fluidstack (Neocloud). Live undisclosed. Private. Appears as a counterparty in TeraWulf’s Abernathy JV discussion; that is not Fluidstack’s own fleet disclosure.
